best_for: Office workers who trade DOCX, XLSX and PPTX files with Microsoft Office users and want a free desktop suite that also edits PDFs and fills in forms.
description:
ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors is a free office app from ONLYOFFICE. One program covers text documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs, so you do not switch apps when you move from a report to a slide deck.

Each file opens in its own tab inside one window, and you can add features through plugins. You can lock a file with a password, encrypt it, or add a digital signature before you send it. If you turn on the AI Tools, they can help write, rewrite and translate text, pull data out of a document, and suggest fields when you build a form. ONLYOFFICE also offers a help center, training courses and webinars for new users.

points.title: Free app, AGPL source
points.text: The desktop editors are free and open source under the AGPL-3.0. ONLYOFFICE sells Enterprise plans with support and an SLA, but you don't need one to use the desktop app.

points.title: Built around Office files
points.text: DOCX, XLSX and PPTX are its native formats, which helps layouts survive the trip to and from Microsoft Office. It also opens ODT, ODS, ODP and CSV.

points.title: Real PDF editing
points.text: You can change text, images and layout in a PDF, highlight and draw, fill in and build fillable forms, and convert a PDF into an editable document.

points.title: Offline first, cloud when you want
points.text: Everything works without internet. To co-edit in real time, connect it to ONLYOFFICE, Dropbox, Nextcloud, ownCloud or another supported cloud.

points.title: AI is optional
points.text: AI Tools are an add-on layer you switch on, with support for your own AI provider, MCP and web search. Nothing AI-related is needed to edit documents.

points.title: Installers and size
points.text: Windows gets 32-bit, x64 and Arm64 installers that install for all users. Macs get separate Intel and Apple silicon .dmg files. The Flathub build is verified as published by ONLYOFFICE, for x64 and Arm64, and takes about 1.1 GB once installed.

points.title: Older versions on Windows
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 36 versions. macOS and Linux list only the current release, so downgrades there need another source.
